description: Synthetic iPhone 17 vectors, 2026-09-07; rounded to six decimal places for deterministic regression tests.

samples.text: Calculus revision: the derivative gives the slope of a curve. Use the chain rule to differentiate composite functions.
In today's calculus lecture we learned how derivatives describe rates of change and practiced the chain rule for nested functions.
DIFFERENTIATION WORKSHEET. Find the derivative of each composite function. Show the chain rule and calculate the tangent slope.
Sourdough baking: feed the starter with flour and water, mix the dough, allow it to ferment, then bake in a hot oven.
For tomorrow's sourdough loaf, refresh the starter tonight. Knead the bread dough and leave it to rise before baking.
BREAD RECIPE. Mix flour, water, salt and active sourdough starter. Bulk ferment the dough and bake the loaf until golden.
SwiftUI development: use State to manage local view data and bindings to update a child view. NavigationStack controls screen navigation.
The iPhone app uses SwiftUI. We fixed a view state bug by passing a binding to the child screen inside the navigation stack.
SWIFTUI NOTES. State stores view data. Binding shares mutable values with child views. Use NavigationStack for navigation.
Japan holiday itinerary: take the train from Tokyo to Kyoto, visit the temples, and book a hotel near Kyoto station.
Let's plan our trip to Japan. After Tokyo we'll catch the train to Kyoto and stay near the station so we can explore the temples.
JAPAN TRAVEL PLAN. Tokyo to Kyoto by rail. Reserve a hotel by the railway station. Spend two days visiting temples.
Saturn's rings consist of icy particles orbiting the planet. A telescope can reveal the rings and some of Saturn's moons.
Tonight we observed Saturn through the telescope. We could see the planet's bright rings and its largest moon, Titan.
SATURN OBSERVATION LOG. Telescope view shows icy rings around the planet and several orbiting moons.
PostgreSQL query optimization: create an index on the customer identifier to avoid scanning every row when finding a customer's orders.
The database query was slow because it scanned the entire orders table. Adding an index on customer_id improved the PostgreSQL query plan.
DATABASE PERFORMANCE. EXPLAIN ANALYZE shows a sequential table scan. Add a customer_id index to speed up order lookups in PostgreSQL.
Marathon training plan: gradually increase weekly running mileage and keep the Sunday long run at an easy conversational pace.
I'm preparing for a marathon. This week's schedule includes an easy long run on Sunday and a gradual increase in total distance.
MARATHON SCHEDULE. Easy-paced Sunday long run. Increase weekly mileage gradually and allow recovery between hard runs.
Guitar practice: switch smoothly between the G, C and D chords while keeping a steady strumming rhythm.
During my guitar lesson we practiced changing from G major to C major and D major without interrupting the strumming pattern.
GUITAR EXERCISE. Practice G-C-D chord changes. Maintain a regular strumming rhythm and clean finger placement.
Tomato seedlings need strong sunlight, regular watering and support stakes. Move the young plants into the vegetable garden after the last frost.
We are planting tomatoes in the garden this spring. Give the seedlings plenty of sun, water them regularly and tie the stems to stakes.
TOMATO GROWING GUIDE. Transplant seedlings after frost. Use stakes for support, water consistently and choose a sunny vegetable bed.
Sewing a cotton shirt: cut the fabric using the paper pattern, pin the pieces together and stitch the seams with a sewing machine.
In sewing class we made a shirt. First we cut cotton fabric from a pattern, then pinned the sections and machine-stitched the seams.
SHIRT SEWING INSTRUCTIONS. Trace the pattern onto cotton fabric. Cut and pin the pieces, then sew the seams by machine.
Photography exposure practice: a wider aperture admits more light and reduces depth of field. Balance shutter speed and ISO for a sharp image.
In photography class we adjusted aperture, shutter speed and ISO. Opening the lens aperture brightens the exposure but blurs more of the background.
CAMERA EXPOSURE TRIANGLE. Aperture controls light and depth of field. Adjust shutter speed and ISO to expose the photograph correctly.
Acid-base titration experiment: slowly add sodium hydroxide to hydrochloric acid until the indicator changes color at the neutralization endpoint.
Our chemistry lab measured an acid concentration by titration. We added sodium hydroxide from the burette and watched for the indicator's endpoint color.
TITRATION LAB. Neutralize hydrochloric acid with sodium hydroxide. Record the burette volume when the indicator changes colour.
French grammar revision: conjugate regular verbs ending in -er in the present tense. Je parle, tu parles, il parle, nous parlons.
Today's French lesson covered present-tense endings for regular -er verbs. We practiced conjugating parler for each subject pronoun.
FRENCH VERB PRACTICE. Present tense of regular -er verbs: parler, je parle, tu parles, nous parlons, vous parlez.
Bicycle repair: fix a punctured inner tube by removing the wheel and tire, locating the hole, applying a patch and reinflating the tube.
My bicycle had a flat tire. I took the wheel off, pulled out the inner tube, patched the puncture and pumped it up again.
BIKE PUNCTURE REPAIR. Remove the tire and inner tube. Find the leak, attach a patch, replace the tube and inflate the tire.
